name: Explorateur Errant
description: Négociateur ouvrant des alliances temporaires entre factions rivales pour des opérations communes ponctuelles.

subject.archetype: Human Diplomatic Combatant - Wandering Explorer of the Belt

loadout.armor_outfit: Ripped and patched mining spacesuit with welded scrap metal plates, asymmetric shoulder pauldrons made from bent traffic signs, duct-taped joints, exposed cables and wiring, fuel-stained work gloves with knuckle guards, magnetic boots showing heavy wear
loadout.arsenal: Hybrid plasma cutter/harpoon rifle with exposed copper coils and taped-on battery pack, weighted谈判用的铁链手套 for intimidation, emergency flare gun strapped to thigh

attitude.behavior: Standing in the crossfire with palms open at shoulder height in peace gesture, one foot forward in balanced combat stance, body angled to face approaching threat while keeping allied forces in peripheral vision, coiled tension in shoulders
attitude.emotion: Determined calm with eyes showing calculated risk, jaw set tight, sweat and grime on weathered face, expression balancing desperate hope with lethal readiness

palette_names.name: Rust Orange
palette_names.role: worn metal accents and battle damage

scenography.setting: Asteroid waystation crossroads junction with corrugated metal walls, makeshift barricades from shipping containers, exposed piping and ductwork, floating debris in zero-g pockets, bullet-scarred surfaces
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Plasma impacts causing sparks and molten debris rain, thick rolling smoke from burning hulls, occasional muzzle flashes illuminating silhouettes, dust particles catching blue plasma glow, alarm lights flickering red
